name: WNBA_R1A4C2_SPECIAL_EVENT_EXCLUSION_AND_PREFIX_CUSTODY_V1
reason_for_correction: The first R1A.4C run treated every ESPN season_type=2 event as regular season and empirically found exactly two extra fixtures per target season. An outcome-blind metadata probe demonstrated that the extras are the annual WNBA All-Star Game and the separate Commissioner's Cup Championship.

special_event_classification.why_exact_ids_are_frozen: 2023 All-Star has an empty notes_headline; 2021 Cup Championship shares the generic Cup headline; Cup qualifying games also carry Cup headlines. Exact game IDs were reconciled outcome-blind against official event dates/participants, then frozen before the corrected rowset run.
